title: On high-girth layered graphs of large Turán density in a hypercube
summary: For a graph $H$, let $\operatorname{ex}(Q_n, H)$ be the largest number of edges in a subgraph of the hypercube $Q_n$ of dimension $n$ that contains no subgraph isomorphic to $H$. We define $π_\square(H)=\lim_{n\to\infty}\operatorname{ex}(Q_n,H)/|E(Q_n)|$ as the Turán density of $H$ in the hypercube. Although determining $π_\square(H)$ for general $H$ remains widely open, Conlon found a large class of graphs with zero Turán density in a hypercube.
